ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'And make my mission easy' mean in Islamic supplications?
ai.summary: This verse, part of Prophet Moses' prayer in Surah Taa-Haa, is widely cited in Shia tradition as a model for seeking divine assistance in both spiritual and worldly matters. It underscores the concept of 'Yusr' (ease) as a direct result of God's will, encouraging believers to turn to Him when facing complex tasks or leadership responsibilities.
